observation_condition: authenticated account at Genius Level 2 (tier noted because member pricing cannot be interpreted without it; no account holder data recorded)

mechanics_verbatim.level_2_rule: Enjoy this level on select stays and rental cars worldwide upon completing 5 bookings in 2 years.
mechanics_verbatim.level_3_rule: Enjoy this level on select stays and rental cars worldwide upon completing 15 bookings in 2 years.
mechanics_verbatim.application: All discounts and rewards are automatically applied when you book
mechanics_verbatim.discount_base: Discounts are applied to the price before taxes and fees.
mechanics_verbatim.identification: participating properties and rental cars carry a blue Genius label

finding_F01.claim: Priority support — the benefit a low-confidence traveller needs most — is gated behind 15 completed bookings in 2 years, so it is structurally unreachable by a first-time traveller.
finding_F01.evidence: Level 3 benefit list includes 'Priority support for stays'; Level 3 qualifying rule is 15 bookings in 2 years, captured verbatim above.
finding_F01.status: This was previously an unverified desk-research hypothesis. It is now observed first-hand on the vendor's own page.

finding_F02.claim: The Genius programme never addresses a first-time traveller anywhere on its own explainer page.
finding_F02.evidence: Full page text (5,250 chars) contains no match for 'first-time', 'new to Booking', or 'beginner'.
finding_F02.caveat: Absence on THIS page only. Not evidence of absence across the product.

our_product_decision_required: Luma is at ideation — nothing built. Decision required: does Luma reward accumulated bookings (which excludes its stated primary user at the moment of greatest need), or invert the model and front-load reassurance to first-time travellers?
Decision required: if support priority is a retention lever, is it earned or granted? Booking.com earns it at 15 bookings; Luma's user has zero.
Decision required: Genius applies discounts automatically with no user action. Luma must decide whether its own value is legible before booking rather than after.
business_goal_link: Scenario business goal 8 — 'Increase repeat bookings and long-term engagement'. Booking.com's answer is a purely tenure-based ladder.
not_observed: whether priority support materially differs in practice (would require a support interaction)
whether tier is visible to partner properties
